# BulkPublish

BulkPublish manages, schedules, publishes, and analyzes social media content across multiple platforms.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bulkpublish/.

## Actions

- **Get Analytics Summary** (read-only): Summarize post counts by status, platform, and day for a required date range of up to 30 days.
- **Get API Request Usage** (read-only): Return today's organization-wide API request count, daily limit, plan, and per-key breakdown.
- **Get Plan Usage** (read-only): Return the connected organization's plan, feature limits, and current resource usage.
- **Get Platform Availability** (read-only): Return current connection and publishing availability for every supported platform and platform variant.
- **List Activity** (read-only): Return one page of organization audit activity, optionally filtered by action or resource type.
- **List Channels** (read-only): Return active connected social channels by default, or inactive channels when active is false, including platform and token state.
- **List Labels** (read-only): Return post or media labels available in the connected organization.
- **List Media** (read-only): Search uploaded media by filename or labels and return one page of files.
- **List Notifications** (read-only): Return one page of organization notifications, optionally restricted to unread items.
- **List Posts** (read-only): Search and filter the connected organization's posts, returning one page and a cursor when more results are available.
